description: BreakPass lets your AI agent reach you outside the chat. When a long task finishes, a decision is waiting, or something goes wrong, your agent sends you a WhatsApp message, an SMS or a phone call, and BreakPass tells it whether you got the message, picked up, and acknowledged. You choose how persistent it is: one message, a message until you confirm, or a message and calls until you answer. An acknowledgement means you saw the alert; it is never approval for your agent to act. BreakPass is not for emergencies or life-safety use.
defaultPrompts: Ask me to acknowledge via BreakPass when the report is ready.
WhatsApp me via BreakPass when the build finishes.
Escalate to me via BreakPass if the server goes down.
